svg.title: Three controls on one data path
svg.desc: A private subnet, gateway endpoint, IAM role, and KMS key around a SageMaker workload. Reachability, authorization, and encryption answer different questions. Test all three for every data path.

g.text: THREE CONTROLS ON ONE DATA PATH
